# 03-self-correction - Self-correction

## Why this topic exists

A first attempt is a draft. This topic covers the shapes that let a system read its own output, say what is wrong with it, and try again. The two papers here are contemporaneous and take different positions on where the critique should live, which is why they are worth reading next to each other.

## Papers in this topic

Noah Shinn, Federico Cassano, Edward Berman and others (2023)

- arXiv: [2303.11366](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11366)
